subject: khafre_pyramid
label: Official original-height summary
caveat: Official summary coexists with detailed survey reconstruction.

subject: khafre_pyramid
label: Core/backing stone
value: Local fossiliferous limestone
caveat: Material context does not write block geometry.

subject: khafre_pyramid
label: Casing system
value: Fine Tura limestone survives at upper levels; published materials study reports granite at base courses
caveat: Course-by-course extent still requires survey evidence.

subject: khafre_pyramid
label: Casing-foundation orientation prior
value: -4.45 arcmin derived rigid-square prior
caveat: Translation/elevation unresolved; individual side residuals retained.

subject: khafre_interior
label: Belzoni entry date
value: 2 March 1818
caveat: Historical event only.

subject: khafre_burial_chamber
label: Burial chamber roof form
value: Rock-excavated chamber with angular/gabled compact-stone roof blocks
caveat: Modern metric geometry requires survey confirmation.

subject: khafre_sarcophagus
label: Sarcophagus setting
value: Sunk into western floor zone with surrounding granite and granite bedding slab
caveat: Do not infer hidden passages from nineteenth-century analogy.

subject: khafre_lower_chamber
label: Historic water stain
value: Perring reported an approximately 12-inch water-stain height
caveat: Not a modern groundwater level or evidence of a hydraulic system.

subject: khafre_valley_temple
label: Valley Temple materials
value: Massive limestone blocks encased in granite, alabaster floors, monolithic granite pillars
caveat: Detailed stone-by-stone provenance needs ARCE/survey records.

subject: khafre_valley_temple
label: Digital Giza find inventory
value: 17 indexed finds
caveat: Catalog count, not excavation-total completeness.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple
label: Digital Giza find inventory
value: 5 indexed finds
caveat: Catalog count, not excavation-total completeness.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple
label: Khafre named architrave
value: Original red-granite architrave bears Khafre titulary; probable pyramid-temple origin; later reused at Lisht
caveat: Probable original placement remains curatorial reconstruction.

subject: great_sphinx
label: Fabric
value: Carved directly from Giza bedrock
caveat: No metric geometry authority.

subject: great_sphinx
label: Khafre attribution
value: Evidence strongly favors Khafre-period construction
caveat: Strong support is not mathematical proof; preserve alternative claims separately.

subject: khafre_lower_complex
label: Relative sequence
value: Valley Temple precedes Sphinx Temple; causeway precedes Sphinx quarry
caveat: Relative sequence, not absolute calendar date.

subject: sphinx_temple
label: Quarry-construction link
value: AERA/ARCE geological mapping links Sphinx-quarry strata to Sphinx Temple core blocks
caveat: Block-source matching is expert interpretation based on mapped strata.

subject: area_c
label: Gallery function
value: Re-excavation favors storage/craft use rather than worker barracks
caveat: Does not by itself identify all occupants/workforce organization.

subject: giza_plateau
label: Plateau geomorphology
value: Pliocene cliff-line context with lithology, joints and faults as morphogenetic controls
caveat: Regional geological context; not a deep-void model.

subject: old_kingdom_chronology
label: Radiocarbon program
value: More than 450 organic samples collected across Old/Middle Kingdom monuments
caveat: Not all samples are Khafre-specific.

subject: old_kingdom_chronology
label: Old-wood caveat
value: Reused/old wood can bias charcoal ages older than construction event
caveat: Radiocarbon offsets must not be read as direct proof of earlier pyramid construction.

subject: giza_plateau
label: World Heritage context
value: Giza lies within UNESCO property 86, inscribed 1979
caveat: Heritage status, not archaeological proof.

subject: khafre_pyramid
label: Facade fracture monitoring
value: 2009–2012 photographic documentation with in-situ verification of major cracks in 2012
caveat: Does not establish ancient crack origin or hidden geometry.

subject: khafre_pyramid
label: ScIDEP status
value: 2025 peer-reviewed paper documents project design/construction and planned multi-view muography; not a finished hidden-void result
caveat: Method/project status only; no hidden-space claim promotion.

subject: khafre_surface
label: 2025 laser survey
value: AERA bibliography records a first laser survey of the Second Great Pyramid; underlying geometry data remain pending access
caveat: Existence of publication does not authorize point-cloud geometry.

subject: khafre_complex
label: Open visual evidence
value: Rights-reviewed Commons assets plus Digital Giza catalog surface provide multi-date visual evidence
caveat: Photos remain visual observations until camera registration and residual QA.

subject: old_kingdom_royal_pyramid_complex
label: Royal funeral / afterlife transition function
value: Royal pyramid complexes functioned as settings for funeral, procession and preparation of the deceased king for the afterlife.
caveat: Functional interpretation applies to the royal pyramid-complex tradition; it does not identify every Khafre architectural detail with one ritual act.

subject: old_kingdom_royal_pyramid_complex
label: Post-burial royal offering cult
value: After burial, priests used pyramid-complex spaces to maintain offerings and ritual service for the deceased king.
caveat: This supports continuing cult function, not a claim that every surviving room has a securely identified ritual use.

subject: old_kingdom_royal_pyramid_tradition
label: Solar kingship context
value: Old Kingdom pyramid architecture participated in an ideological environment of increasingly prominent solar kingship.
caveat: General Old Kingdom context is not a Khafre-specific inscription proving a particular encoded solar message.

subject: old_kingdom_state
label: Centralized-state context
value: The pyramid-building environment operated within a highly centralized royal state capable of planned monumental landscapes and concentrated administration.
caveat: State capacity explains coordination context; it does not by itself establish the monument’s religious meaning.

subject: khafre_valley_temple
label: Repeated royal statuary in Valley Temple
value: Multiple Khafre statues/fragments are cataloged from the Valley Temple; official museum record describes one 168 cm diorite statue as one of about 23 similar statues.
caveat: Presence of statuary does not by itself reconstruct exact statue positions or a unique ritual action.

subject: khafre_valley_temple
label: Kingship/unification iconography
value: Official museum description links the enthroned Khafre image with sema-tawy unification symbolism and Horus protection.
caveat: Iconographic meaning belongs to the statue/object context and cannot be projected onto every temple action.

subject: khafre_causeway
label: Statuary find associated with causeway
value: Digital Giza indexes a limestone statue head as a Khafre Causeway find.
caveat: Find association does not establish original display position or processional use.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple
label: Royal titulary at court doorway
value: Met curatorial reconstruction places Khafre’s cartouche on a red-granite architrave spanning a court doorway, with falcon/statue imagery associated with the piers.
caveat: Exact original pier/doorway placement requires primary excavation/plan reconciliation.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple
label: Royal statuary in pyramid temple
value: Digital Giza indexes a lower part of a diorite striding statue of Khafre and another statue fragment among five finds from the pyramid temple.
caveat: Find inventory does not establish exact ancient placement.

subject: old_kingdom_royal_pyramid_complex
label: Offerings/readings directed to royal images
value: Digital Giza describes living priests presenting offerings and religious readings to statues of the deceased king as part of the post-burial royal offering cult.
caveat: General Old Kingdom royal-complex function; exact Khafre room-by-room rite remains unresolved.

subject: khafre_valley_temple
label: Dual east entrance with goddess associations
value: The east façade is reconstructed with two entrances; source synthesis associates Bastet with the north entrance and Hathor with the south.
caveat: Associated flanking sphinx/lion reconstruction remains interpretive.

subject: khafre_valley_temple_t_hall
label: 23-position Valley Temple statuary field
value: The T-shaped hall preserves/reports 23 floor niches, with a 3/7/3/7/3 arrangement in Seidel’s reconstruction.
caveat: Specific statue-to-niche assignments remain reconstructed.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple
label: Pyramid Temple room program
value: Independent scholarly synthesis and Hölscher’s excavation monograph converge on pillared halls, a court, five chapel/serdab-like cult spaces, side/magazine spaces and a western inner zone.
caveat: Exact room outlines require plan-byte parsing and modern survey reconciliation.

subject: khafre_pyramid_temple_statue_court
label: Statue-court reconstruction remains non-unique
value: Physical emplacement evidence supports major statuary/stone installations, but statue type/pose and exact court reconstruction differ among Hölscher, Ricke, Arnold and Jánosi.
caveat: Do not render one disputed reconstruction as canonical ancient reality.

subject: khafre_lower_complex
label: Room topology is ahead of metric plan custody
value: Room-level topology can now be source-addressed, while the highest-value 1:100 ARCE Valley Temple plan and key Hölscher plates are not yet checksum-bound local source bytes.
caveat: Topology must remain schematic until source bytes and metric frame receipts exist.
